test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters T, P, K, G, R, and U are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea11783cad84af1078e1b3c8f88f86191a4a9db357e8f4e3cf9a7da05c34ad58.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: Two opposite faces of the dice are never adjacent to each other.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afe1e1f6936f42db5a96701ee2f12d8940ef0411cd16376588655f485156f79a.png] 

⇒ In the given T is common in both the dice.

⇒ Figure is rotated in a clockwise direction from the common letter T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f16811e313c3a65ea655d9794073f7d76b6d018be1de98ee414724763e4e05b.png] 

Clearly, U is on the face opposite to K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
